constraints: If menu is a menu reference (MenuRef), the process parameter is unnecessary and is ignored if passed; if menu is a menu number, process (if passed) designates which process's menu bar to use, defaulting to the current process.

overloadMerges.note: Corrected direction: iconRef is filled in by the command ('←' in the docs), not passed in.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the menu

params.name: iconRef
params.description: Reference (pathname via the 'path:' pattern, or, depending on the variable's declared type, the number or 'pictlib:' name) of the icon associated with the menu item; blank if no icon is associated.
